concept_context.title: Elliott–Halberstam conjecture
concept_context.description: The primes have every level of distribution θ<1, in the averaged arithmetic-progression error sense, with arbitrary logarithmic saving.

reviews.evidence: FORMAL STATEMENT ONLY; no proof or truth of the Elliott–Halberstam conjecture is claimed. Define level(theta) by the exact fully spelled-out predicate below, then the catalogue conjecture is literally forall theta:Real, theta<1 -> level(theta). This imposes every theta<1, arbitrary positive epsilon and arbitrary positive logarithmic-saving A; it does NOT assert a completed proof of any positive level. Mathlib 26573066084e6e2aa8526ea358bc43b66d96f970. Exact checked generic bare definition, choosing explicitly the standard von-Mangoldt-weighted, ALL POSITIVE MODULI, reduced-residue MAXIMUM, FIXED-x convention. For q>=1 and a:(ZMod q)units, define psi(x;q,a)=sum over m in Finset.Ioc 0 floor_nat(x), with (m:ZMod q)=a, of ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt m. Put E(x;q)=Finset.univ.sup' (nonempty witness unit1) (fun a => abs(psi(x;q,a)-x/(Nat.totient q:Real))). Then level(theta) is forall real A>0,forall real epsilon>0, (fun x:Real => sum q in Finset.Icc 1 floor_nat(x^(theta-epsilon)), E(x;q)) =O[atTop] (fun x => x/(Real.log x)^A). Real powers are rpow; eventual x>1 avoids all small-x conventions. Actual Finset.sum (generated additive protected prod):66 is finite underlying-multiset sum; Finset.sup':529 and sup'_le_iff:555/le_sup':561 certify an actual finite maximum, with units nonempty via1 even for q=1. VonMangoldt:65 is log(minFac m) for prime powers and0 otherwise, actual pow/prime identities86/89 checked; totient:38 is cardinal reduced residues (units/card comparison112 checked in042). Asymptotics.IsBigO:86/isBigO_iff:99 is precisely an eventually bounded constant multiple, so choosing it AFTER A,epsilon permits constants depending on both. No assertion that any theta satisfies this predicate, no Bombieri–Vinogradov/Elliott–Halberstam proof, and no claimed equivalence to a stronger supremum-in-y normalization. Actual defining bodies/hypotheses checked, no new proof development.
